messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
So I set off on my merry little way, my schoolbag on my back, trying to find the seventy-six bus stop.

output.original_text: So I set off on my merry little way, my schoolbag on my back, trying to find the seventy-six bus stop.
output.joy: So I happily set off on my merry little way, my schoolbag on my back, excitedly trying to find the seventy-six bus stop.
output.sadness: So I trudged off on my lonely little way, my schoolbag heavy on my back, searching for the seventy-six bus stop.
output.fear: So I cautiously set off on my little way, my schoolbag feeling heavier on my back, nervously trying to find the seventy-six bus stop.
output.anger: So I stomped off on my irritating little way, my schoolbag weighing me down, frustrated as I tried to find the seventy-six bus stop.
output.surprise: So I unexpectedly set off on my little way, my schoolbag on my back, taken aback while trying to find the seventy-six bus stop.
output.disgust: So I begrudgingly set off on my unappealing way, my schoolbag slung over my back, disgusted as I tried to find the seventy-six bus stop.
